newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse clarifies banks, finance suspension.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse clarifies banks, finance suspension.

text.p: Thailand's stock exchange said on Monday that it had suspended trading in banks and finance company counters for today's trading session only.
Earlier the exchange issued a statement saying that the counters were suspended, without giving a time frame, while material information relevant to them was awaited from the Bank of Thailand.
The central bank and the finance ministry announced details later on Monday of measures to restore confidence and boost liquidity in the finance and banking sector.
